title: Guesnon performs his original 'Going Home Blues' for Rolf's band
summary: He sings his own composition as a favor for Rolf and his band in Sweden and sends greetings to a banjo player.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
